purpose: Declarative MCP tool contracts for handoff packets.

tools.name: handoff_task
tools.description: Package current task context in SloplessCode for pickup by another CLI tool. Use when: (1) current model hit its limit, (2) you want to manually switch to another CLI. Stores context with status=pending. Returns memory_id and pickup instruction for the target CLI.

from_agent.description: This CLI: claude-code | codex | cline | gemini-cli

to_agent.description: Target CLI: claude-code | codex | cline | gemini-cli

project_id.description: Optional project scope for playbook-aware handoffs

phase.description: Current task lifecycle phase, e.g. task_framing

priority.description: Human-readable priority like high, medium, low

owner_agent.description: Optional agent that owns the write scope for this packet

write_scope.description: Optional bounded areas this packet may modify

definition_of_done.description: What counts as sufficient completion for this iteration

expected_output_shape.description: Expected shape of the receiving agent's output

execution_mode.description: Execution policy mode that biases cost/quality routing for this packet

background_job_type.description: Optional existing background job type for safe queued execution

background_payload.description: Optional payload for background job dispatch

include_project_context.description: When project_id is set, attach a compact enrich-task context snapshot

context_max_components.description: Max components to include in the attached project context snapshot

task_description.description: Full task description to hand off

partial_result.description: Any partial work done so far

key_facts.description: Up to 10 key facts the next agent needs

from_model_id.description: Optional cloud model/component that hit a limit, e.g. 'claude-sonnet'

tools.name: pickup_handoff
tools.description: Retrieve pending task handoffs addressed to this CLI agent. Call this at the start of a new session or when you expect a handoff from another CLI. Marks retrieved handoffs as picked_up to prevent double-processing.

agent_id.description: This CLI's identity: claude-code | codex | cline | gemini-cli

handoff_label.description: Optional human-readable label to narrow pickup to one task

owner_agent.description: Optional agent that owns the write scope for this packet

write_scope.description: Optional bounded areas this packet may modify

tools.name: list_pending_handoff_labels
tools.description: List human-readable labels for pending handoffs addressed to this CLI agent. Use this before pickup when you want to see which named handoffs are waiting.

agent_id.description: This CLI's identity: claude-code | codex | cline | gemini-cli

tools.name: list_handoffs
tools.description: List task packets/handoffs for this CLI agent filtered by lifecycle status. Use this to inspect active, paused, picked_up, closed, or archived packets, not only pending pickup.

agent_id.description: This CLI's identity: claude-code | codex | cline | gemini-cli

handoff_label.description: Optional human-readable label to narrow listing

owner_agent.description: Optional agent that owns the write scope for this packet

write_scope.description: Optional bounded areas this packet may modify

tools.name: handoff_workspace_summary
tools.description: Return a compact overview of the current handoff workspace for an agent. Includes total packets, breakdowns by status/owner/phase, and compact recent packet lines.

agent_id.description: This CLI's identity: claude-code | codex | cline | gemini-cli

handoff_label.description: Optional human-readable label to narrow summary

owner_agent.description: Optional current owner to narrow summary

write_scope.description: Optional required write-scope entries to narrow summary

packet_limit.description: How many recent compact packets to include

tools.name: decompose_task_packet
tools.description: Build a deterministic recommendation for splitting a larger task into bounded task packets. Returns packet stubs with suggested labels, phases, write scopes, and iteration contracts.

project_id.description: Optional project scope for project-aware playbook guidance

task_description.description: The larger task to split into bounded packets

handoff_label_prefix.description: Optional label prefix for the suggested packet stubs

phase.description: Preferred task lifecycle phase for the suggested packets

priority.description: Priority to copy into the suggested packet stubs

owner_agent.description: Optional default owner to assign to the suggested packets

execution_mode.description: Policy mode that biases decomposition toward quality or economy

write_scope.description: Candidate bounded write scopes or work areas

max_packets.description: Maximum number of packet stubs to recommend

tools.name: create_task_packets
tools.description: Materialize recommended packet stubs into real task packets. Use after decomposition when you want to create multiple bounded task packets at once.

from_agent.description: Source CLI: claude-code | codex | cline | gemini-cli

to_agent.description: Target CLI: claude-code | codex | cline | gemini-cli

project_id.description: Optional project scope for project-aware packet creation

task_description.description: Fallback task description used when a packet stub does not override it

execution_mode.description: Fallback execution mode used when a packet stub does not override it

partial_result.description: Optional partial result carried into each created packet

key_facts.description: Up to 10 key facts carried into each created packet

packets.description: Recommended packet stubs to materialize as real task packets

owner_agent.description: Optional owner for the created packet

write_scope.description: Bounded write scope for the created packet

execution_mode.description: Execution mode for the created packet

background_job_type.description: Optional background job type for the created packet

suggested_execution_tier.description: Suggested execution tier for the created packet

model_hint.description: Suggested model hint for the created packet

expected_output_shape.description: Expected output shape for the packet

phase_objective.description: Phase objective carried into the packet

core_instinct_ids.description: Core instinct IDs for the packet

supporting_instinct_ids.description: Supporting instinct IDs for the packet

tools.name: route_task_packet_execution
tools.description: Route a handoff packet to the best execution target using its packet payload or memory_id. Returns packet profile, routing basis, eligible executors, and the recommended executor.

tools.name: dispatch_background_task_packet
tools.description: Dispatch a handoff packet through the background job queue after routing confirms a background executor. Queues the packet's supported background_job_type and returns the job id and polling location.

memory_id.description: Existing handoff memory UUID to dispatch through the background job queue

tools.name: reconcile_background_task_packet
tools.description: Reconcile a dispatched background job for a handoff packet after the queue updates its status. Returns the job state, packet lifecycle state, and any result or verification summary.

memory_id.description: Existing handoff memory UUID with a dispatched background job

tools.name: expand_handoff_refs
tools.description: Resolve referenced project context from a handoff packet on demand. Use this after pickup when the compact handoff summary is not enough and you need selected laws, components, improvements, runtime hints, tasks, or docs sections.

memory_id.description: Handoff memory UUID returned by pickup_handoff

limit_per_type.description: Max resolved items per ref type

tools.name: refresh_handoff_context
tools.description: Refresh the compact project context attached to a handoff packet from current project knowledge. Use this when resuming an older handoff so its summary and refs reflect the latest state.

task_description.description: Optional task text override used for refresh

owner_agent.description: Optional agent that owns the write scope for this packet

write_scope.description: Optional bounded areas this packet may modify

max_components.description: Max components to include in refreshed refs

tools.name: update_handoff_status
tools.description: Update the lifecycle status of a task packet/handoff. Use this to mark a packet as active, paused, closed, or archived after pickup.

acted_by.description: Who is updating the packet lifecycle

owner_agent.description: Optional agent that owns the write scope for this packet

write_scope.description: Optional bounded areas this packet may modify

executor_used.description: Optional executor used for the packet lifecycle update

model_used.description: Optional model used for the packet lifecycle update

result_summary.description: Short summary of the bounded result being merged back

verification_summary.description: Short verification note for the bounded result

reason.description: Short reason for the status change

tools.name: resume_handoff
tools.description: Resume a paused or picked-up task packet. Sets the packet status to active and optionally refreshes compact project context from current knowledge.

task_description.description: Optional task text override used during refresh

owner_agent.description: Optional agent that owns the write scope for this packet

write_scope.description: Optional bounded areas this packet may modify

max_components.description: Max components to include if refresh runs
